title: Review notes reach a fake agent as one prompt, and the review's commit goes through
notes: trix 1.4.0's alt+v review sends every note as one multi-line prompt and commits with git. Gaps in trix-probe hid both: the fake agents never turned on bracketed paste, so trix typed the prompt a line per Enter and the agent took only its first line as the turn; the fake took trigger words from every line, so a note or quoted code with exit or rm in it ended the agent or asked for permission; and the sandbox HOME had no git identity, so the review's commit failed with 'unable to auto-detect email address'. Needs trix 1.4.0 for the review.
